Bulgaria. In 2019, the Bulgarian Commission for Protection of Competition (BCPC) fined the National Electricity Company EAD (NEK) for abuse of dominance. NEK is part of Bulgarian Energy Holding, which owns 80 percent of all hydropower plants in Bulgaria.
